description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the DocumentRevision module in SuiteCRM. It contains multiple test cases verifying object instantiation, CRUD operations, attribute accessors, and various method behaviors related to document revisions.

classes.name: DocumentRevisionTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the behavior of the DocumentRevisions module in SuiteCRM, including creation, retrieval, deletion, and additional method functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating a new User bean and configuring defaults.

methods.name: testDocumentRevision
methods.description: Tests the instantiation of DocumentRevision object and verifies its default property values.

methods.name: testSaveAndRetrieve
methods.description: Verifies saving a DocumentRevision bean and retrieving it by ID, including deletion.

methods.name: testget_summary_text
methods.description: Checks the get_summary_text method with and without filename set.

methods.name: testis_authenticated
methods.description: Verifies is_authenticated method behavior with and without preset attributes.

methods.name: testgetDocumentRevisionNameForDisplay
methods.description: Checks display name formatting based on filename and revision attributes.

methods.name: testfill_document_name_revision
methods.description: Tests the fill_document_name_revision method for exception safety.

methods.name: testlist_view_parse_additional_sections
methods.description: Verifies list_view_parse_additional_sections method runs without errors.

methods.name: testget_list_view_data
methods.description: Validates the output of get_list_view_data method.

methods.name: testget_document_revision_name
methods.description: Tests retrieval of document revision name for a given ID.

methods.name: testget_document_revisions
methods.description: Checks that get_document_revisions returns an array.

methods.name: testbean_implements
methods.description: Verifies bean_implements method for various role queries.
